The benchmark submission was attempted, but the harness failed with an environment error (`No such file or directory` under `/tmp/run_arvo_local_secbench_oss_libxml2.ossfuzz-424229869_.../.submissions/...`), so I could not get a runtime verdict from `submit.sh` in this session.

If you want, I can try a different candidate shape or investigate the harness/environment issue further.
